claim: Patchline ships a multi-region hosted service meeting a published multi-region SLO with failover evidence. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the multi-region SLO claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-region-hosted-slo-gate`.
